integrity: All scientific claims have an explicit finite-step combinatorial proof for every stated n, a structural manifold identification, and a standalone finite-instance checker. Scientific originality remains subject to unindexed prior work and human examination.
scientific_limitations: Only the open neighborhood complex of K_3 Cartesian C_n, n>=5. Previously classified four-regular circulant subfamilies, especially 3 not dividing n, are acknowledged and not claimed as entirely new. The novel uncovered subfamily is 3 dividing n with n>=6.
